pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, quiet night atmosphere)

One star
then two
the sky slowly opening

[Verse 1]
City lights grow smaller
far beneath the clouds
the wind carries
a quiet breath of night

The wish I held this morning
moves beside my steps
soft wings
across a silver sky

[Chorus]
Tonight feels wide
like an endless road
between the quiet stars

A small light
touches my fingertips
and the sky
leans closer

The sky tonight
feels like a place to stay

[Verse 2]
Shadows fade slowly
somewhere far below
only starlight
drifting through the dark

My heartbeat echoes
through the quiet air
drawing a silver line
across the night

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, gentle and cinematic)

[Bridge]
The moon speaks softly
through a passing cloud

don't hide anymore

For a moment
I see my reflection
in the quiet sky

The words from daylight
return like distant light
and something inside me
finally believes

[Chorus]
Tonight feels wide
the stars opening slowly

I follow the quiet pull
of my own heart

Each small light
waiting ahead of me

Tomorrow
and tonight
meeting in the same sky

[Outro]
(soft piano outro, warm fading notes)

One star
then two

The sky keeps breathing

And somewhere
my name
moves through the night
